NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author pushed twice since the feedback, but the commit messages and the +37/-0 size are unchanged. They then asked @Asteriskkkk for review.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ❌ | The commit history still lists "Merge branch 'main' into fix-view-all-users-focus" next to the main commit, so the cleanup asked for was not done. |
| ℹ️ | The visual fix is approved in the CZO thread and has before/after screenshots for both themes. |
| ℹ️ | The comment asks @Asteriskkkk to review, but nobody is assigned to the PR. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to rebase onto main to remove the merge commit, then post again to request review.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! The history still has a "Merge branch 'main'" commit. Please rebase onto main so only the focus-styling commit remains (see the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html)), then post again to request a review.
```
